questions.prompt: Which hook is used to add local state to a functional component?
questions.explanation: useState returns a state variable and a setter function for local component state.

questions.prompt: When you want to set state after receiving data from an API, which hook should you use?
questions.explanation: useEffect runs after render and is ideal for performing side effects like fetching data and updating state.

questions.prompt: What does lifting state mean in React?

options.text: Moving state up to a parent component
Moving state down to a child component

questions.explanation: Lifting state moves the state variable to a common ancestor so that child components can receive it via props.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of using React Context?

options.text: Provides a way to share global state
Ensures components re-render on every state change

questions.explanation: Context does not automatically force re-renders on every change; components subscribe to context changes selectively.

questions.prompt: Which scenario best suits useReducer for state management?

options.text: Complex state logic with many sub-values

questions.explanation: useReducer is useful when state transitions are complex and involve multiple sub-values or branching logic.
